title: Choose from labels
summary: PL/SQL: Choose from labels. Try yellow. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: CASE matches a value with labels. ELSE is a fallback. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Use an Oracle practice database and SQL Developer Run Script or SQL*Plus. Run the whole block, including SET SERVEROUTPUT ON and the final slash. The result shown is DBMS_OUTPUT text.

blocks.title: Choose from labels

blocks.text: The green string matches the second WHEN branch, which writes Go.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Without an ELSE, an unmatched statement CASE can raise an error.
